```python
from nltk.corpus import wordnet

def replace_synonym(text, target_word):
    synonyms = set()
    for syn in wordnet.synsets(target_word):
        for lemma in syn.lemmas():
            synonyms.add(lemma.name())
    # Filter out similar words (e.g., "spread" vs. "spreader")
    synonyms = [syn for syn in synonyms if syn != target_word]
    return f"Replace '{target_word}' with: {synonyms[:3]}"  # Top 3 synonyms

print(replace_synonym("spread", "spread"))
```
